atlas_research_hypothesis.query: Formulate an empirical multi-timeframe trading hypothesis for XAUUSD (RANGE_SPECIALIST). Observed microstructure physics: personality=STOP_HUNT_MEAN_REVERTING, wick_to_body=3.023, trend_persistence=0.269, mean_reversion=0.731. Learned timeframe weights: D1 (w=+0.215), M30 (w=+0.207), H4 (w=+0.199). Ablation-retained features: liquidity_sweep (w=+0.232), rsi_momentum (w=+0.156), dealing_range_reversion (w=+0.155), pulse_social_sentiment (w=+0.134) (pruned/left out by ablation: none).
atlas_research_hypothesis.hypothesis_statement: Atlas & Forge empirical synthesis for XAUUSD (RANGE_SPECIALIST): Data shows STOP_HUNT_MEAN_REVERTING microstructure (wick/body=3.023, mean-reversion=0.731). Multi-timeframe return regression assigns highest predictive weight to D1 (w=+0.215), M30 (w=+0.207), H4 (w=+0.199). Controlled leave-one-out ablation retained [liquidity_sweep (w=+0.232), rsi_momentum (w=+0.156), dealing_range_reversion (w=+0.155), pulse_social_sentiment (w=+0.134)] and pruned [none].

penalty_hierarchy.unnecessary_early_stop_counterfactual_pe: If trade stops out early (breakeven or early close) and post-exit price action reaches Major TP without hitting initial SL, charge forgone_tp_r penalty.

mtf_intelligence_and_sensitivity_report.design_rule_enforced: Contextual weighted agreement: trades are evaluated via learned timeframe weights and never rejected solely because all 7 timeframes do not point in the same direction.

data_synchronization_audit.candle_close_semantics: Higher-timeframe values become available only after bar_open + timeframe_duration <= trigger_close.
